about.title: Newport Beach Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: Defective products do not announce themselves. In Newport Beach, an injury might come from a pressure cooker lid that gives way, an e-bike battery that overheats, a child seat that unlatches, or an airbag that never deploys in a crash on Jamboree Road or MacArthur Boulevard. Whatever the item, California law gives injured people a meaningful advantage. Product liability claims often proceed on strict liability, so you generally do not have to prove the company was careless. You need to show the product carried a defect — in its design, in how it was manufactured, or in its warnings — and that the defect caused your harm. Liability can extend beyond the manufacturer to the distributor and the Orange County retailer that sold it. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that connects Newport Beach residents with an independent personal injury attorney who takes product cases on contingency, meaning no fee unless there is a recovery. Hold onto the product, and let us make the introduction.

whyChoose.title: Why Newport Beach Residents Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Strict liability shifts the focus to the product
items.desc: California often does not require proof that a manufacturer was negligent. The attorney we connect you with can concentrate on showing the defect and the injury it caused.

items.title: Three types of defect, one clear path
items.desc: Design flaws, manufacturing errors, and missing or inadequate warnings are each recognized under California law. An independent attorney can help identify which category fits your situation.

items.title: Every link in the supply chain matters
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and retailers may all share responsibility for a defective product. That wider net matters when the maker is overseas or hard to reach.

items.question: My airbag or seatbelt failed in a crash on Rt 1 in Newport Beach. Is that a product claim?
items.answer: It may be, and it can run alongside a claim against the other driver. Newport Beach recorded 419 injury collisions in 2025, with Rt 1, W Coast Highway, and Jamboree Road among the higher-volume corridors, and safety equipment that does not perform as designed can turn a survivable crash into a serious injury. If you can, keep the vehicle from being repaired or scrapped until an attorney has reviewed it, because the car itself is evidence.

items.question: Do I have to prove the manufacturer did something wrong?
items.answer: Generally not. California product liability often runs on strict liability, which means you typically need to show the product was defective and that the defect caused your injury. Whether the company was careful or careless is usually beside the point. An attorney can walk you through what evidence tends to matter most.

items.question: Should I throw away the product that hurt me?
items.answer: Please do not. The product is often the single most important piece of evidence, and losing it can make a claim much harder. Store it somewhere safe, keep the packaging, receipts, and any instructions, and photograph everything before anyone else handles it. LawProactive can connect you with an attorney who will explain how to preserve it properly.
